parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

webpackMode.description:
The mode to use for Webpack. It should fall back to App.mode if not set. If App mode is 'dev' or 'trial',
webpack will use 'development' mode; if App mode is 'prod' or 'test', webpack will use 'production' mode.

Webpack mode changes preset configurations that alter generated files.

 - "development" Generates source maps and unobfuscated code.
 - "production" Generates minimized and obfuscated code. Optimizes for size and runtime performance.

bundlerMaxMem.description:
The maximum amount of memory to allocate to the Webpack bundler.
This will limit the child process that runs Webpack to this amount of memory.
Note that if multiple child processes are spawned, each process will be allocated this amount of memory.
The maximum amount of memory for the parent process is determined by the NodeJs {@link ImplLanguage#Runtime}.

disableExtraFilesLoader.description:
Enabled by default. DISABLING IT WILL IMPACT BUNDLING PERFORMANCE.

When true, {@link UiSdlExtraFilesInvalidatingCacheLoader} will be disabled and importing files in `ui/c3/src`
must be done from `@c3/app/ui/src/`.

When set to false, files in ui/c3/src will be copied into @c3/ui and exposed as federated modules,
making modules larger and slower to build.

cacheGenFiles.description: Whether to cache and reuse code generated files.
